content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the Raichur District Block Coordinator Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 07-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of Raichur District to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Raichur District Block Coordinator recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Raichur District Block Coordinator positions is 07 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Block Coordinator post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies for the Block Coordinator post in Raichur District.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required qualification for the Block Coordinator role?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduate degree in IT (BCA, BSc in Computer Science or IT) with a minimum of 60% marks or an equivalent qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Block Coordinator position is 40 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Block Coordinator position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 20,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Block Coordinator posts?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on marks obtained in Qualification (50 marks), Experience (25 marks), and an Interview (25 marks).

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is entirely online. Candidates need to apply through the official Raichur District website.

faq.question: Q9. When does the application process start?
faq.answer: The application process for the Raichur District Block Coordinator recruitment starts on 24 September 2026.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the online application link in the "Important Links" section of this article.
